# NEW 2026-11-22 v15.5 Stars of East Asia — Northern Yuan Revival Bridge Yearly Hook & Story Dispatcher (oe_nyu_) (0 vanilla overrides, 0 mainline slots). Generated by gen_v155_east_se_asia.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Zero-slot yearly kernel hook (called from oe_gk_yearly_dispatch once per year globally).
oe_nyu_kernel_yearly = {
	if = {
		limit = { current_year >= 1368 NOT = { global_var:oe_nyu_ran_y ?= current_year } }
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_nyu_ran_y value = current_year }
		if = {
			limit = {
				country_exists = c:YUA
				c:YUA = {
					is_rebel_country = no
					num_locations > 0
					OR = {
						is_ai = no
						NOT = { oe_rule_is_global_arcs_player_only = yes }
					}
				}
			}
			c:YUA = { oe_nyu_story_tick = yes }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				country_exists = c:OIR
				c:OIR = {
					is_rebel_country = no
					num_locations > 0
					OR = {
						is_ai = no
						NOT = { oe_rule_is_global_arcs_player_only = yes }
					}
				}
			}
			c:OIR = { oe_nyu_story_tick = yes }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				country_exists = c:MGE
				c:MGE = {
					is_rebel_country = no
					num_locations > 0
					OR = {
						is_ai = no
						NOT = { oe_rule_is_global_arcs_player_only = yes }
					}
				}
			}
			c:MGE = { oe_nyu_story_tick = yes }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				country_exists = c:CHI
				c:CHI = {
					is_rebel_country = no
					num_locations > 0
					NOT = { owns = location:dadu }
					culture = { has_culture_group = culture_group:mongolian_group }
					NOT = { has_or_had_tag = MNG }
					NOT = { has_or_had_tag = MCH }
					OR = {
						owns = location:karakorum
						owns = location:shangdu
						any_owned_location = { region = region:mongolia_region }
					}
					OR = {
						is_ai = no
						NOT = { oe_rule_is_global_arcs_player_only = yes }
					}
				}
			}
			c:CHI = { oe_nyu_story_tick = yes }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope: fires at most one oe_nyu historical event per yearly tick.
oe_nyu_story_tick = {

		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_nyu_ev1_done }
